episode_title: Budget 2026, QuickBooks Updates and the Xero Ultra Debate | Ask the Accountant #209

real_qa.q: What is the eligibility criteria for the new Founders Relief scheme announced in Budget 2026?
real_qa.r: According to the budget announcement, HMRC estimates that only about 600 people per year will be entitled to the Founders Relief scheme. The scheme has very restrictive eligibility criteria that make it practically unattainable for most business owners, despite being presented as a positive relief.

real_qa.q: When will Making Tax Digital quarterly payments requirements come into effect?
real_qa.r: From 2029, businesses will be required to make quarterly payments as part of Making Tax Digital. This was predicted as an inevitable development once the initial filing wave completes, with the quarterly payment regime being connected to a revised payment account system.

real_qa.q: What is the tax cost increase for business acquisitions completed after April 5 2026?
real_qa.r: If a business acquisition is completed after April 5th 2026 with a sale price of £1 million or more, it will cost an additional £30,000 in tax compared to completing before that deadline. This change in the capital gains tax regime accelerates the timing for acquisition completions.

real_qa.q: What is the new mileage allowance rate for business mileage claims?
real_qa.r: The mileage allowance rate has been increased to 35 pence per mile, with the previous 55 pence rate now becoming permanent rather than temporary. This change provides more clarity for businesses claiming vehicle expenses.

real_qa.q: What is the new threshold for claiming trading expense relief without detailed records?
real_qa.r: A new £3,000 threshold allows traders to claim that amount in expenses without being required to provide detailed explanations or records. This exists alongside the existing £1,000 tax return threshold, creating additional complexity in the tax system.

guest.bio_context: Aaron Patrick is the co-host of Ask the Accountant Podcast, appearing alongside Johan Goy every Monday morning at 8:30. He participates in advisory boards and attends accounting conventions and entrepreneur festivals. He was present at the Xero Roadshow and actively engages with budget analysis and tax policy discussions.
